nurse.text: Hello there, bor! That's Norfolk for neighbour. Welcome to Norwich Sanctuary.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop 'em on the counter. A dab of warmth, a cup of tea, and they'll be right as rain. No mustard. Well, a little.
There you go, all better. Don't you go getting on the huh, now. That means crooked, wonky. You'll pick it up.
The Ark's in the corner. It was made by a Strangers' carpenter, they say. It's a bit of squit, that story. Nonsense, I mean.

else.text: Fare you well, then! That's what we say. Mind the cobbles on Elm Hill.
